title: sushi mod
body:
This is a mod made with mcreator that adds sushi to Minecraft.![To make sushi, you need the corresponding fish.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04a85d554936926f1ec8f5784a3abf12386658e6.gif)


Tuna, salmon, shrimp, rice and corresponding sushi will be added.



Add the tuna and salmon, created on the block bench.![Tuna and Shrimp Mob](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd1554ae3058e5cdf6dbe20392fc99e3006e9ca6.png)




Add a sushi bar reminiscent of Japan's Edo period.
Inside is a barrel filled with sushi.![Sushi Bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/609207b20fb397427b44aa97a4d5b8ad4c9276ff.png)
